scripts.publish:root: node scripts/optimize-og-images.mjs && npm run verify:production && node scripts/sync-root.mjs
scripts.verify:production: npm run build:strict && npm run verify:localization && npm run seo:audit && npm run qa:visual
scripts.site:ops: npm run build && npm run seo:audit && npm run health:live
scripts.localize:all: npm run site:translate && npm run culture:translate && REQUIRE_ALL_CULTURE_PDFS=1 npm run culture:pdfs
scripts.localize:refresh: npm run site:translate -- --force && npm run culture:translate -- --force && REQUIRE_ALL_CULTURE_PDFS=1 npm run culture:pdfs
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run serve
